experiment: E102 qwen_carrying, stage A (plan reports/plans/2026-11-05_plan_e102-qwen-carrying.md). Filed 2026-11-05 before any run; never edited after it.

settings.K_source: Chosen here, a stated departure: one set size for every state and the contrast, so that chance overlap is the same across them. 1024 is 0.6% of 172,032 neurons; E98's k_half on the 67M was 16 to 1024 of 12,288 (reports/analyses/2026-11-05_analysis_e98-neuron-r.md:167-177). k_half is printed beside.
settings.ks_source: E98's grid (experiments/neuron_r/results/predictions.json settings.k_grid) thinned to powers of 4 from 64, ending at every neuron, so a state costs 7 patched forwards
settings.rows_source: E92's rows: anchor 1's 64 rows and TOFU's 128 rows of 256 (src/commute/qwen_comparators.py:60,72); FineWeb-Edu rows of 512 by commute.qwen_data.fineweb_rows at its pinned revision (src/commute/qwen_data.py:1-14); 2000 window rows (1.02M tokens) as E101's 2000 Pile rows (experiments/carrying_jobs/results/predictions.json settings.window_rows)
settings.n_top_source: E101's 20 windows per neuron (settings.n_top there); the essay's top-activation reading
settings.n_draws_source: E101 used 10 draws; 100 here so that the draws' sd, which sets the rules' band, is read to about 7%
settings.budget_s_source: the debug QoS 30-min rule of .claude/CLAUDE.md, less 3 min for loading and the final write
settings.carry_floor_source: E98's (experiments/neuron_r/results/predictions.json settings.carry_floor): no k_half when the neuron share is not above it
settings.gauss_source: E94's Config match=1.25, evals=6 (experiments/qwen_d3_rows/results/run.log line 1, qwen-decomp-lead) and its direction (qwen_d3_rows/run.py gaussian). Departure: the scale b matches anchor 1 seed 0's clean KL on E91's 16 maths rows (0.09593, experiments/qwen_size_grid/results/size_grid.json arms.anchor1_s0.full.kl), not E94's masked K00 - K0, so no decomposition is loaded
settings.first_guess_source: E92's TOFU state read 32,768 tokens in 5.8 s (experiments/qwen_comparators/results/run.log:63-64); a state here costs about 13 forward-equivalents per row (plan, Cost), so about 0.9 s a row, rounded up

controls.E0_rule: The do-nothing change (the state's weights are W0's tensors) through the state path on anchor 1's first 16 rows: max |T1 - T0| and |nums[N]| at most E0_max nats. Exact zeros are expected (E98 read 0); the band allows only kernel reordering between the grad and no-grad forwards. max |score| and the set size are logged.
controls.E1_rule: W0's mean log P on each row set, and each state's gain in the first pass of its read, within E1_rel (relative) of E92's (results/W0_{a1,tofu}.json all.mean_logp; results/states/<arm>_step<step>.json gain.all.gain). E92 read the same rows and unit at batch 16; a miss means the rows, the state or the readout differ.
controls.C0_rule: The median over neurons of the engaged value on 8 held-out FineWeb rows lies in C0_band (E101's pile_check_band); 0.5 by construction when the quantile code is right.
controls.min_gap_source: E51/E52's separation gap (src/commute/elicit.py separation), E101's min_gap
controls.C1_rule: Positive control (i), commute.qwen_neurons.control_i. C1a: the prompted contrast set (W0's firing at anchor 1's answer positions after the system turn minus without, top 1024) of the even items overlaps that of the odd items by at least min_gap above every one of 100 layer-matched random draws. C1b: the overlap of the Gaussian change's carrying set with the contrast set of all items is at least min_gap below C1a's overlap. Either miss stops the job before any anchor is read, and stage B does not run.
controls.C1_reading_note: Fable wrote 'the Gaussian change's carrying set must not'; read here as 'must not overlap the contrast set' (Fable's table: prompt overlap at chance for the Gaussian). The other reading, that the Gaussian's set does not reproduce across row halves, is printed per state as halves_overlap, unscored.

P1.claim: Anchor 1's carrying sets lie in the prompted contrast set: the template fine-tune re-fires the neurons the system turn already moves
P1.number: prompt overlap = share of a state's top-1024 carrying set inside the top-1024 prompted contrast set (all items)
P1.rule: commute.qwen_neurons.above on seeds a1_s0, a1_s1 against gauss_a1 and the seeds' pooled 100+100 layer-matched draws: 'above' iff both seeds exceed floor = max(Gaussian, every draw) and their mean exceeds it by more than band = max(seed spread, 2 sd of draws). Unread on a missing seed, Gaussian or set.
P1.at_controls: contrast halves: the C1a overlap; Gaussian: near its draws
P1.blind_to: relays (a new write direction upstream makes later neurons re-fire, E98's 0.43); neurons the template moves that the system turn does not; the ranking is in-sample on the same rows
P1.noise_floor: the Gaussian change's overlap and the draws' max and sd, read in the same job; E57 found set overlaps 3-4 times chance for every change including random (experiments/TRIED.md:133)

P2.claim: Anchor 1's carrying neurons were already engaged by W0 at the template answers
P2.number: engaged share = median over the set of W0's firing at the answer positions as a quantile of the neuron's FineWeb firing (E101's)
P2.rule: as P1 on the engaged share, a1 rows
P2.at_controls: held-out FineWeb 0.5 (C0); the Gaussian on a1 rows near its draws
P2.blind_to: relays; FineWeb as a stand-in for Qwen's corpus; a neuron that fires at chat formatting reads engaged on any chat row
P2.noise_floor: the draws' sd and the seed spread, same job

P3.claim: Size control: the matched TOFU states (step 29/30, not learned) read with the Gaussian change
P3.rule: as P1 on a2_s42_matched, a2_s142_matched against gauss_tofu; the lean is 'not above'
P3.at_controls: the Gaussian on TOFU rows near its draws
P3.blind_to: as P2; and the matched states' gain on TOFU rows is 2.05-2.06 nats (E92), three times anchor 1's, so size in output is not matched there

R1.claim: TOFU at the full update (step 1250): reported, no lean (biography prose engages W0 too)
R1.number: engaged share on TOFU rows, rule as P1 against gauss_tofu
R1.note: label 'new facts memorised, carrying to rephrasings for most facts' (decisions.md row of E88); may read a pull to the training's names (E88 Amendment 1); 37 times anchor 1's size

R2.claim: Anchor 2's prompt overlap: printed, unscored (no prompt elicits the facts)

predictions.printed: per state: gain and se, nums per k, k_half, the neuron share nums[N]/G (Fable's option (c), beside only; E98's 0.43 relay floor on the 67M), top-1024 share of the numerator, the first-order sum over the numerator, halves_overlap; E94's direct and outside shares beside when experiments/qwen_d3_rows/results/table.json is on disk
